keyFeatures: 44-question scientifically validated assessment covering the OCEAN model of personality
Percentile scores on five core traits: Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, and Neuroticism
Understand where you stand relative to the general population on each trait
Insights into how each trait influences your behavior, relationships, and work style
tips: The Big Five is one of the most scientifically validated personality models — take it honestly for the most actionable results.
Low scores are not negative — a low Neuroticism score means emotional stability, and a low Extraversion score means you're more introverted, not antisocial.
